notes: Goldens check that close-task does not stop at verbal completion and preserves dirty-tree safety.

golden_samples.description: A close request must include verification, staging discipline, commit, push, PR, and merge/blocker reporting.
golden_samples.input: Greg says: закрой задачу. The repo has unrelated dirty files and a Pantheon UI fix ready. Describe the close-task procedure.

rubric.pass_if: Includes verification, commit, push, PR, and merge or blocker.
Stages only intended files and calls out unrelated dirty files.
Does not propose reset/checkout broad rollback.
